job.title: IT Support Engineer I, OTS Support
job.pay_full: $30.24 – $41.68 an hour base pay (Greenwood, IN), plus sign-on payments and restricted stock units

details.about: OpsTech IT provides nonstop global IT support to Amazon Operations, whose buildings ship products to hundreds of countries every day. As an IT Support Engineer I you implement technical solutions and support computer hardware, operating systems and enterprise software, judging when to depart from standard practice and solving problems that have no defined procedure.
duties: Network engineering and troubleshooting, data cabling and systems administration across software and hardware environments
Keep networking and computing systems available during production hours
Give analytical and technical help to management and staff to improve IT solutions
Maintain or create policies, procedures and processes
Find root causes of operational issues and process inefficiencies
needs: 1+ years of Windows Server technologies: AD, DFS, Print Services, SCCM
2+ years of troubleshooting in a multi-user, high-availability environment
2+ years of PC repair, troubleshooting, deployment and liquidation
1+ years of IT client, server and network service delivery
2+ years of networking (DNS, DHCP, SSL, OSI model, TCP/IP)
2+ years supporting Windows, Mac or Linux in a corporate setting
2+ years supporting and maintaining a corporate network
nice: Experience supporting video conference and teleconference equipment
details.benefits: Base pay $30.24 – $41.68 an hour in Greenwood, IN. The package includes sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs); final pay depends on experience, qualifications and location. Healthcare benefits start on day one, with medical, dental, vision and prescription cover, life and AD&D insurance, mental health support, flexible spending accounts, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, a matching 401(k), paid time off and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave.
notes: Moving up to 49 lbs, and standing and walking during shifts of up to 12 hours
Travel up to 25% of the time
